health_notes: Post-illness recovery in Jun 2026 is long behind him — fully back to training.
Medial knee niggle (mild) flared once in Jun 2026 — resolved with rest. Relevant to snowboarding (edge loading, falls): keep light single-leg step-down / glute maintenance 2x/week.

VO2max ~55.8 (top 5% for age/gender) and resting HR ~47: aerobic engine is strong, so the 2.4km run is expected to be his best IPPT station. Push-ups and sit-ups (muscular endurance) are the likely limiters — but this is UNTESTED, confirm with the baseline test.
key_context: PIVOT (15 Nov 2026): the Sep 2026 half-marathon goal is DONE/dropped. Do NOT reference HM predictions, VDOT race paces, long runs to 16-17km, July mileage targets, or Norway. Running is now in service of the 2.4km IPPT station + general aerobic base only.

IPPT = 3 stations: 1-min push-ups, 1-min sit-ups, 2.4km run. Gold = 85+ total points (Silver 75-84, Pass 51-74), and each station must score at least 1 point. Age group at TEST DATE determines the scoring table — the athlete is turning 28-30 on 19 Feb; if he tests BEFORE his birthday he may fall in the younger (harder) age band. Use the official IPPT scoring table for the right age band; never guess point values — if unsure, say so.

Baseline: NOT tested recently. Week of 16-22 Nov is a BASELINE TEST WEEK: max push-ups in 1 min, max sit-ups in 1 min, all-out 2.4km (outdoor track/route, record time). Results are logged in ippt_log.json and drive every later prescription.

Snowboarding prep (beginner): the trip is 20-27 Feb, the day AFTER the IPPT test. Build leg endurance (squats, wall sits, single-leg work, step-downs), core and glute strength, ankle/hip mobility, balance (single-leg, BOSU if available), and wrist/shoulder resilience (push-up work already covers a lot). Falls are inevitable for a beginner — prioritise injury resilience over max strength. Do NOT schedule heavy leg days in the last ~5 days before the IPPT test or trip; arrive fresh, not sore.

Training-load logic: push-up/sit-up volume is the main driver of IPPT scores — use greasing-the-groove (frequent submaximal sets through the day), density/ladder sessions, and weekly max-rep re-tests. Running: 2.4km-specific work (400m/800m repeats at goal pace, one tempo, easy aerobic runs HR <=135). Keep ~2 hard sessions per week max and never 2 hard days back-to-back.
Gym: Snap Fitness Buangkok (across the road) — available for squats, leg press, core, cable work.
Daily habits: stairs up on return home; push-ups + sit-ups morning routine (now treated as training — count volume).
Shoe rotation: ASICS GEL-KAYANO 31 for easy runs; DYNAFISH XIAONIAN (lightweight) for intervals/time trial/2.4km tests. Xiaonian is already broken in.
Watch: Garmin logs strength_training / hiit / cardio activities — use them (reps/duration/load) for strength-session tracking. IGNORE walking activities (company project, not training).
